ENGLISH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.

2. When practising Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives, which approach is best? (1 mark)

7. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. goed
   C. goes
   D. going

8. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. No full stops

9. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)

10. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)

   B. Where is the library?

   B. quickly
   C. run
   D. happiness

13. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only a describing word
